title: Diverse Corpus, Performance & Interoperability Proof
start_authority: Owner Continue on 2026-08-26 America/Chicago after fresh verification of AIOC main 280047bb214ff425a3488406dc7bb09f5ecba922 and application main 3f7c893939779337ca01510ec24ff2c346d200f0, re-reading completed MAI-01..09 evidence, the approved performance standard/source and the final-program DPL-14 proof pattern, then resolving a bounded read-only corpus/performance/interoperability proof contract.
objective: Implement the final MAI proof tranche as read-only composition over completed MAI-01..09: demonstrate representative source/capability diversity, deterministic interoperability and approved-budget performance evidence without creating a new owner ledger, canonicalizing a vendor/pack or weakening permission/provenance boundaries.

corpus.search_dataset: Deterministically expand the fourteen source classes into a bounded alpha search/filter dataset; corpus expansion is proof data only and does not create new source authority.
corpus.evidence_rule: Use repository-supplied/starter/fixture evidence only. Source, checksum, license, permission, provenance and unsupported metadata remain explicit. No vendor, editor, provider or pack is canonical or assumed complete.

performance.method: One warm-up followed by five measured iterations for bounded corpus operations; record platform-specific samples, median and maximum. Correctness/provenance/owner boundaries may not be weakened to meet performance.

hard_budget.acceptance: median measured bounded-corpus search/filter time must be below 150 ms on each required platform

performance.rule: No numerical budget is invented where approved sources provide none. Raw timings are evidence and may differ by platform.

interoperability.acceptance: Every declared corpus case either traverses its applicable completed stages with preserved evidence or terminates in an explicit supported negative/degraded state. Unsupported capability is evidence, not permission to guess or silently discard.
interoperability.owner_rule: Proof never derives World, Scene, Visibility, gameplay or D29 publication truth from visual/corpus evidence.

determinism.receipt: Canonical corpus identities, stage verdicts, diagnostics, owner-boundary booleans and normalized performance budget verdicts yield a platform-neutral mai10-fnv1a32-* receipt.
determinism.timing_exclusion: Raw wall-clock samples, medians and maxima are excluded from the deterministic receipt; they remain platform-specific Validation Core evidence.
determinism.cross_platform: Linux and Windows must produce the same deterministic MAI-10 receipt and the same normalized budget/interoperability verdicts.

persistence.result: No MAI-owned durable corpus, benchmark or interoperability ledger is required; fixtures/contracts/tests and Validation Core artifacts are sufficient proof evidence.

program_completion.rule: MAI-10 completion may close MAI only after exact-head application Repository Health, self-hosted Linux and Windows MAI-10 profile evidence and deterministic cross-platform comparison pass. AAI-01 remains unauthorized until separate post-closeout selection.

validation_contract.focused: Add MAI-10 deterministic corpus/interoperability proof contracts, bounded performance measurement regression and verifier covering positive, degraded and fail-closed cases plus receipt order independence.
validation_contract.predecessors: Preserve MAI-09..01 and MIB-11/D18 owner regressions; retain all permission/provenance and owner boundaries.
validation_contract.final_gate: Exact candidate head must pass Repository Health, self-hosted Linux and Windows Validation Core, deterministic cross-platform comparison, focused MAI-10 regression and declared predecessor/owner regressions before merge.

implementation_preflight_repairs: governed report aligned to exact MAI-06 adapter IDs without weakening verify_mai_10.py
partial-import corpus evidence now executes a real MAI-06 multi-level LDtk partial import with ldtk-multi-level-partial diagnostic and raw-source preservation
validation_blocker.github_status_evidence: No workflow runs or commit statuses registered on PR #321 exact candidate after open, reopen, content-neutral synchronization and substantive repair commits.
validation_blocker.rule: Do not merge PR #321 or close MAI-10 until fresh exact-head Repository Health, self-hosted Linux, self-hosted Windows and deterministic comparison evidence passes. Queued predecessor reruns are diagnostic only and cannot validate MAI-10.

preserved_boundaries: MAI-01..09 completed evidence remains binding and has no further implementation authority
no vendor/editor/provider or pack becomes canonical Multiversal truth
no pack is assumed complete and semantic requirements remain separate from selected art
unknown/denied/revoked permission remains ineligible; visibly-unresolved cannot activate
unsupported/partial/ambiguous source evidence stays explicit rather than guessed or discarded
MIB-11/D18 owns World; A5 owns runtime Scene; Visibility/Permissions owns visibility; Combat/Exploration and Action owners own gameplay; D29 owns publication/provenance
MAI-09 receipts remain orchestration evidence only
performance proof cannot trade correctness, accessibility, privacy, audit history or deterministic rules behavior for speed
migration 0022 remains unreserved absent a separately demonstrated durable schema delta
no provider acquisition/download/authentication/scraping/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation
AAI-01 remains unauthorized until MAI-10 is completed_verified and separately closed/selected
